title: "Reference"
subtitle: "Every option the veil extension accepts."
description: "Look up the filter entry, the content syntax, every option under extensions.veil, and what Veil validates."
---

## Enable

```yaml
filters:
  - veil
revealjs-plugins:
  - veil
```

The filter runs at the stage `pre-quarto`, before Quarto numbers sections and resolves cross-references.
The `revealjs-plugins` entry has no effect in other formats.

## Content

| Syntax | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `.veil` | Marks an element as veiled. |
| `group="a b"` | Joins the element to the groups `a` and `b`. Without it, the element joins the group `veil`. |

: Attributes of a veiled element. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[25,75]"}

See [Authoring](authoring.qmd) for the elements that you can tag.

## Configuration

```yaml
extensions:
  veil:
    groups:
      - name: advanced
        level: 1
        shown: true
        label: Advanced
      - name: expert
        level: 2
        shown: false
      - name: backup
        shown: false
    state: "level:1,-backup"
    keys:
      menu: "u"
      level-up: "]"
      level-down: "["
    button:
      enabled: auto
      position: bottom-left
    toast: auto
```

### Options

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `groups` | list | No | discovered | Declared groups, in the order of the popover. |
| `groups[].name` | string | Yes | | The group name, as used in `group="..."`. |
| `groups[].level` | integer, `>= 1` | No | | The position on the ladder. Without it, the group is independent. |
| `groups[].shown` | boolean | No | `true` | The default state of the group. |
| `groups[].label` | string | No | the name | The text in the popover and the toast. See [Labels](#labels). |
| `state` | string | No | | A state that replaces the `shown` values. See [State and sharing](state.qmd). |
| `keys.menu` | string | No | `u` | Opens and closes the popover. |
| `keys.level-up` | string | No | `]` | Moves the ladder setting one level up. |
| `keys.level-down` | string | No | `[` | Moves the ladder setting one level down. |
| `button.enabled` | `auto`, `true`, `false` | No | `auto` | `auto` shows the button in `html` and not in `revealjs`. |
| `button.position` | `top-left`, `top-right`, `bottom-left`, `bottom-right` | No | `bottom-left` | The corner of the button. |
| `toast` | `auto`, `main`, `speaker`, `false` | No | `auto` | Where the toast shows. |

: Veil options. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[18,18,9,12,43]"}

### Labels

The popover and the toast show a label as plain text.
Quarto reads a label as Markdown, and Veil keeps this text as you wrote it:

- HTML, for example `<b>A</b>` or `<T>`.
- Quotes around a word, for example `'x'` or `"x"`.
- An apostrophe in a word, for example in `Don't`.
- Hyphens and dots, for example `--`, `---` or `...`.

Veil removes Markdown marks such as `*` and backticks, and keeps the text in them.
Typographic punctuation shows in its ASCII form, so `—` shows as `---` and `’` shows as `'`.

### Interface language

The interface text follows the document language.
Veil has English and French text.
Set `lang` to pick one, and English is used for any other language.
To change a text or to add a language, set these Quarto `language` keys, for example in a `_language-xx.yml` file or in the document:

| Key | English text |
| --- | --- |
| `veil-name` | `Veil` |
| `veil-level` | `Level` |
| `veil-groups` | `Groups` |
| `veil-none` | `none` |
| `veil-shown` | `shown` |
| `veil-hidden` | `hidden` |
| `veil-open-popover` | `Open the Veil popover` |
| `veil-level-up` | `Show the next level of content` |
| `veil-level-down` | `Hide the current level of content` |

: Veil language keys. {.striped .hover}

The key `veil-name` names the button, the popover and the entry in the Reveal.js menu.
The key `veil-open-popover` and the two level keys describe the keys in the `?` help of Reveal.js.
Group labels are not translated, so set `groups[].label` for each language.

## Validation

- A group name must match `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$`.
  Any other name stops the render with an error.
- Veil writes a warning, and does not stop the render, in these cases:
  - A declared group is not used in the document.
    Veil does not write this warning when the document has no veiled element, or when the document is a page of a project rendered to an HTML format.
  - The document uses a group that you did not declare.
  - A `keys` entry is the same as a Reveal.js key, a Quarto key, or another `keys` entry.
    The runtime does not bind this key.
  - The default states of the ladder are not consistent.
  - The `state` option has an unknown token.
  - The format is `revealjs`, the chalkboard is enabled, and the document has veiled slides.
  - The format is `revealjs`, the document has veiled content, and no `revealjs-plugins` entry names `veil`.
  - A `.veil` Div contains `---`.
  - In a static format, a cross-reference points to removed content.

## Limitations

::: {.callout-caution}
Veil does not support `.veil` on a tab header of a tabset, on a callout title, or on the title slide.
See [Authoring](authoring.qmd#positions-that-veil-does-not-support) for the alternatives.
:::

- A block cannot span two slides.
- The state does not follow the reader to another page of a book or a website.
- Quarto search indexes hidden content.
- Chalkboard drawings use slide indices, so they can move after a change.
  See [Reveal.js notes](reveal-notes.qmd).
